_comment: Hand-entered hero-galaxy values, one reference each. These override the photometric
shape derived from 2MASS, which for a large inclined spiral measures the old stellar
isophote and not the disc plane: M31's 2MASS axis ratio 0.473 gives 64 degrees where
PROVENANCE HONESTY. Every value here is class Inferred, not Measured, and the reason is
the evidence chain, not the physics. The chain is: the cited paper -> the project's
binding design document docs/design/2026-09-11-B-data.md section 2.11 rule 4, which
states these values and their citations -> this file. The lane that wrote this file did
not read the papers. docs/DATA-LICENCE-AMENDMENT.md section 0 is explicit that a claim
is only as strong as the weakest link in its chain, and B-data itself marks these
'(Corbelli+2010, INFERRED values)'. A number transcribed from a document is an Inferred
number however good the underlying measurement is. Anyone who reads the papers may
promote these to Measured and say so here.

overrides.reference: Corbelli, Lorenzini, Walterbos & Braun 2010, A&A 511, A89 (H I rotation curve of M31); transcribed from docs/design/2026-09-11-B-data.md section 2.11 rule 4, paper not read by lane data-galaxies
overrides.note: The 2MASS J+H+Ks axis ratio 0.473 gives 64.06 deg through the Hubble q0=0.2 formula. The kinematic value is the disc plane; the photometric one is the isophote.

overrides.reference: Corbelli et al. 2014, A&A 572, A23 (M33 H I disc); transcribed from docs/design/2026-09-11-B-data.md section 2.11 rule 4, paper not read by lane data-galaxies
overrides.note: M33's 2MASS shape fails the LGA reliability guard (shapeReliable false), so without this override the galaxy is drawn round and faint.
